description: Kenya - Production of Rice in Irrigation Schemes is a data set listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by Kenya National Bureau of Statistics (inactive). Dataset shows rice production in various irrigation schemes over the last five years. The total area cropped increased by 25.1 per cent from 21.9 thousand hectares in 2017 to 27.4 thousand hectares in 2018. Coverage: Kenya. The portal files it under the publisher Kenya National Bureau of Statistics (inactive). Its tags are food security, livelihoods. It offers 1 resource(s) in XLSX. The portal shows 2025-02-06 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support irrigation network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
